# Security policy

## Supported versions

The following versions of MSC-Tender-Hunter-Agent receive security updates:

| Version | Supported |
|---|---|
| [< 1.0] | No |

If you use an unsupported version, upgrade to a supported version before reporting.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Do not report security vulnerabilities through public issues, discussions, or pull requests.

Report vulnerabilities privately using one of these options:

- **GitHub private vulnerability reporting:** Open the [Security and quality tab](https://github.com/JuniorThanhBQ/MSC-Tender-Hunter-Agent/security) of this repository and select Report a vulnerability.

- **Email:** thanh.vantrung2005@gmail.com.

## What to include

To help us assess the report quickly, include as much of the following as you can:

- The type of vulnerability, for example cross-site scripting, SQL injection, or authentication bypass
- The affected version, component, and file paths
- Step-by-step instructions to reproduce the issue
- Proof-of-concept code or a request that demonstrates it, if available
- The impact, including how an attacker might exploit it
- Any special configuration required to reproduce it
- How you would like to be credited, if at all

## What to expect

These are our targets. Actual times may vary.

- **Acknowledgment:** within 7 days of your report
- **Initial assessment:** within 7 business days, including whether I accept the report
- **Status updates:** at least every 14 days until the issue is resolved
- **Fix and release:** Each version will be numbered as vX.X.X. Security patches are typically part of the third X-numbered rapid patch release.

If I decline the report, I will explain why.

## Disclosure policy

I follow coordinated disclosure:

1. I confirm the vulnerability and determine the affected versions.
2. I prepare fixes for all supported versions.
3. I release the fixes and publish a security advisory.
4. I credit the reporter in the advisory, unless they ask to remain anonymous.

Please keep the vulnerability confidential until I publish a fix, or until 7 days after your report, whichever comes first. If you need a different timeline, tell us in your report.

## Scope

**In scope:** Repositories, packages, services, or domains covered by this policy for which patches are available

**Out of scope:** Repositories, packages, services, or domains that are not covered by this policy or for which there are no available patches to resolve this issue.

## Contact

For questions about this policy that are not vulnerability reports, contact thanh.vantrung2005@gmail.com.
